summary: Frontend-only testing of 360° Car Showcase. All core functionality (initial load, button navigation, active state, image swap, shortest-path animation, preloading) works correctly. Minor responsive overflow on mobile width.

issues: controls-wrapper overflows horizontally - 'Left' button gets clipped by viewport edge. The pill bar with 4 buttons + 1rem gaps + 1.5rem padding exceeds 390px. Consider reducing button padding (e.g., 0.5rem 1.25rem) or gap below 640px breakpoint, or allow wrapping/horizontal scroll.

action_items: Fix mobile (<640px) responsive: controls-wrapper overflows, 'Left' button clipped. Reduce button horizontal padding or gap at small breakpoints.
critical_code_review_comments: CarShowcase.js line 44: ((diff + 4) % 8) - 4 — JavaScript % preserves sign of dividend so for negative diff the result can fall outside [-4, 4]. e.g. diff = -6 -> ((-6+4)%8)-4 = (-2)-4 = -6. Should use ((diff % 8 + 12) % 8) - 4 for true mathematical modulo to guarantee shortest-path. Currently works for the 4 mapped buttons but fragile if more angles added.
App.css: controls-wrapper has no responsive sizing — overflows on viewports < ~430px. Add @media (max-width: 480px) reducing button padding/gap.
Minor: image_refs stored in ref but never used after preload — could simply use a counter without holding Image refs.
